## What to do next (in order)

### 1) Run AUB autopilot (module-level search + select best)
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --run --select-best
```
**Expected outcome:** generates/updates module experiment results and (with `--select-best`) should pick the best-performing module configuration candidate(s) per your scoring rules.

- Any newly created candidate JSON(s)
- A summary table showing deltas vs `baseline/champion_v5_latest.json`

### 2) Run system autopilot (system-level candidates)
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml --run
```
**Expected outcome:** evaluates system-level candidate combinations (often slower / more end-to-end), producing scores comparable to the champion.

**What to check after it finishes:**
- A report listing candidates and their `tuning_*` and `lockbox_*` metrics
- Whether any candidate improves both **mean** and **min** (or at least the metric your selection policy prioritizes)

### 3) Generate “next fix” recommendations
```bash

```

- any generated report paths
- the best candidate JSON filename(s), if one was selected

…and I can tell you whether to promote a new champion, which metric regressed, and what the “next fix” is likely targeting.
